scope.purpose: Preserve how JANUS Habitat/Nexus evolved, including successful primitives, compatibility witnesses, supersessions, bounded failures, exact-head integration evidence and remaining launch blockers.
scope.ordering_rule: GitHub source created_at is used where available. Later exact-head evidence remains bound to the exact historical input SHA even if a producer branch advances afterward.

status_vocabulary.IMPLEMENTED: Primitive exists; this label alone does not claim integration acceptance.
status_vocabulary.COMPONENT_VERIFIED: Dedicated or exact-head component evidence passed in its bounded scope.
status_vocabulary.PARTIAL_VERIFIED: A bounded workflow passed while inherited or compatible integration remained red/open.
status_vocabulary.INTEGRATION_VERIFIED: Compatible multi-component view passed the stated exact-head evidence surface.
status_vocabulary.HISTORICAL_WITNESS: Preserved valid evidence for an earlier exact view; it may be superseded for current integration use without deletion.
status_vocabulary.OPEN: Required launch property is not yet established.

chronology.milestone: NOHAND + fenced SWARM + deliberate process death closes controlled G8/G9/G11
experiment: worker-A persists admitted objective and executes bounded #158 segment
SWARM assert_current executes immediately before durable checkpoint delegate
NOHAND request/response/state and handoff receipt become durable
worker-A deliberately exits with code 77 without graceful session continuity
worker-B starts as a fresh interpreter using durable filesystem inputs only
worker-B takes over with a new fencing token and reproduces worker-A checkpoint receipt
worker-B completes through an exactly-once transaction
reconstructed stale worker-A token is rejected with LeaseFenceLost before checkpoint delegate
chronology.development_effect: First integrated proof in this path that a worker process can die, a clean process can recover only from durable state, stale ownership cannot commit after takeover, and completion remains exactly once in the controlled scope.
